end.hint: Each character's end snapshot is read once the ESI cache expires (10 min at most). Anything mined afterwards does not count.

depart.confirm: Your end snapshot will be taken now. You cannot come back.

snapshot.reconnectStart: {name} needs reconnecting: start snapshot not read, quantity unknown

closing.waitingText: The operation ended at {end}. ESI caches the mining ledger for 10 min: each character's end snapshot will be read at {ready}.
closing.nothingEstimated: Nothing is estimated in the meantime.
closing.snapshotsHint: ESI ledger per character · end minus start
closing.departed: {name} left at {time}: their characters' end snapshots were taken when they left.

quantities.title: Mined quantities
quantities.unknownBanner: {name} has an unknown quantity: it is not counted as 0. An owner or admin can correct it.
quantities.allSystems: Counted in every system: mining outside the operation during the window is included

correction.title: Correct a quantity
correction.card: The owner or an admin can correct a quantity (forgotten alt, mining off site). The correction is tracked: who, when, original value.

boostFit.label: Boost ship and compressors

badgeHint.on_site: Compressible on site by a mounted compressor
badgeHint.no_hull_compressor: No compressor of this kind exists for this hull
badgeHint.not_mounted: The hull can mount it, but no such compressor is declared as mounted
badgeHint.unknown_ore_kind: Ore kind unknown: not compressible as far as the SDE tells

boostFit.noHullBanner: The {ship} cannot compress {kinds}: gross volume to haul.
boostFit.notMountedBanner: No compressor mounted for {kinds}: gross volume to haul.
boostFit.sharesUnchanged: The value of the shares does not change: one raw unit counts as one compressed unit.

stockpileCoverage.title: Your Stockpile
stockpileCoverage.intro: Share of the deficit of each mineral in your Stockpile that this operation covers, from your own mined ore reprocessed at your yield.
stockpileCoverage.yieldUnknown: Reprocessing yield unknown: configure your reprocessing yield
stockpileCoverage.nothingToReprocess: No reprocessable ore mined in this operation
stockpileCoverage.error: The Stockpile coverage could not be loaded

valuation.title: Valuation
valuation.noCutEachForThemselves: no cut when everyone keeps their own
valuation.rule: G = Σ quantities × unit price of the basis. Booster: G × {booster} %. Corporation: G × {corporation} %. Each participant: their value × {rest} %, to the ISK; the rounding remainder goes to the largest fractions.
valuation.ruleEachForThemselves: Mined value = Σ quantities × unit price of the basis, for each participant. No share, no payment.

shares.title: Value prorata split
shares.pricesRead: prices read at {time} · {market} sync {synced} · recomputed on every read
shares.checkEachForThemselves: Σ mined values {total} = G ✓ · no share computed
shares.unknownBanner: Total value and shares unknown. Nothing is counted as 0. Causes: {causes}.
shares.eachForThemselvesBanner: Everyone keeps their own ore: no share, no payment. Prices are read now.

freeze.title: Freeze shares
freeze.hint: Current prices are copied into the operation and the shares stop changing. Payments come next.
freeze.confirm: Freeze the shares now? Settings can no longer change.
freeze.frozenBanner: Shares frozen on {date} EVE. Quantities, prices and shares no longer change.

blockers.each_for_themselves: Everyone keeps their own: no shares.
blockers.booster_missing: Choose the booster who receives the booster cut.
blockers.fleet_storage_exceeds_mined: Delivered quantity above what was mined: {names}

archive.myValue: my value · everyone keeps their own
archive.empty: No settled or completed operation yet.
archive.hint: The archive lists the settled or completed operations you took part in, and your corporation's operations open to the corporation.

season.hint: Operations of your corporation that ended within the period. Hours are the presence of each player, from their first start snapshot read to the end of the operation.

unknownBanner.title: Season value unknown
unknownBanner.text: {count} operation has no frozen value yet: its hours are counted, its ISK is not. The known value and the ISK/h leave it out. | {count} operations have no frozen value yet: their hours are counted, their ISK is not. The known value and the ISK/h leave them out.

ships.title: ISK/h per ship
ships.empty: No character with a known ship in the operations with a frozen value.
ships.unknownCharacters: {count} character without a known ship, left out of this table | {count} characters without a known ship, left out of this table

season.empty: No operation of your corporation ended within this period.

payments.title: Payments
payments.rule: Everyone keeps their ore and gives the booster the difference between their mined value and their share. The booster passes the corporation cut on. An owner or admin ticks the line once the ISK is given in game.
payments.ruleCorporationOnly: Everyone keeps their ore and gives the corporation the difference between their mined value and their share.
payments.ruleFleetStorage: The fleet storage recipient owes each depositor their share minus what they kept.

kind.booster_cut: booster and corporation cuts on their mined value
kind.corporation_cut: corporation cut on their mined value
kind.collected_corporation_cut: corporation cut collected by the booster ({percent} % of G)
kind.fleet_storage_share: fleet storage: holds the delivered ore, owes their share minus what they kept

payments.pendingTrace: waiting for the ISK to be given in game

settle.title: Mark settled
settle.hint: Available once every payment is marked paid. The operation then moves to the archive, read only.
settle.confirm: Mark the operation settled? Nothing can change afterwards.
settle.banner: Operation settled on {date} EVE. Every payment is marked paid. Quantities, prices, shares and payments no longer change.

complete.title: Mark completed
complete.hint: Current prices and each participant's mined value are copied into the operation, which moves to the archive, read only. Nothing to settle.
complete.confirm: Mark the operation completed? Current prices are frozen.
complete.banner: Operation completed on {date} EVE · everyone keeps their own. Nothing to settle. Prices and mined values are frozen.

fleetStorage.title: Fleet storage
fleetStorage.rule: Each participant declares whether they deliver their ore to the recipient. The recipient owes each of them their share minus what they kept, and pays the booster cut on all the ore they hold.

verification.title: Corporation container “{name}”

reason.operation_not_ended: Checking starts once the operation has ended.
reason.operation_archived: Archived operation: the container may have been emptied.
reason.not_corporation_member: Corporation assets are only shown to corporation members.
reason.assets_synced_before_end: Corporation assets read at {time}, before the operation ended ({end}).
reason.container_not_found: No “{name}” container in the shared divisions.

verification.noEffect: This check does not block freezing the shares: the debt follows the declaration.
